## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md updated (annotate retired keys as DEPRECATED)

## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] BRIDGE_ENV_ID section annotated with the canonical DEPRECATED phrase
  Verify: grep -qE 'DEPRECATED.*stateless reconciler.*4047-3cb1-6cb4-46a1' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] BRIDGE_ENV_ID key itself preserved (searchability)
  Verify: grep -q 'BRIDGE_ENV_ID' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] Every CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md row classified as 'document-as-historical' in the audit table is annotated
  Verify: grep -c 'DEPRECATED' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | awk '{ if ($1 < 1) exit 1 }'

## Implementation Notes
Read docs/findings/2026-residual-bridge-state-audit.md (produced by T1). For every audit row whose path is plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md AND classification is 'document-as-historical', add the annotation `DEPRECATED (stateless reconciler — see epic 4047-3cb1-6cb4-46a1)` adjacent to the retired sentence/key. Preserve the key name and surrounding context — annotation is ADDITIVE, never deletion.

Specifically: the BRIDGE_ENV_ID section at line 2126 references "BRIDGE_ALERT migration semantics: the first run after BRIDGE_ENV_ID transitions from empty emits a one-shot alert" — this is the prev_snapshot-semantic dependency. Annotate it.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
